channel.title: Midnight Sun
channel.desc: Drama 2014 Fourteen-year-old Luke, who lives in the icy Arctic with his family, stumbles upon a young polar bear cub named Nanuk who's wandered far from home. Feeling compassion, Luke sets out to help Nanuk, and together they endure numerous hardships. Dakota Goyo, Goran Visnjic, Bridget Moynahan, Duane Murray, Peter MacNeill, Roger Spottiswoode, Bart Gavigan.
